methodology: Primary source verification from official docs, developer portals, and prior research artifacts. Every claim marked with evidence type: verified (measured from primary source), reported (credible secondary source with URL+date), inferred (logical deduction), hypothesis (unconfirmed).

platforms.entity_required: Enterprise developer account (foreign corp OK for dev account; procurement needs China receiving entity)
platforms.auth: AppKey + AppSecret + OAuth 2.0 access_token + MD5 signature
platforms.catalog_access: Full site via alibaba.product.get (not just own products); item_search, item_search_img; wholesale sourcing APIs (alibaba.wholesale.goods.search, alibaba.wholesale.supplier.get)
platforms.order_model: Procurement tracking via alibaba.trade.get, orderList.get, refund.get; buyer places order on your platform → you call 1688 procurement API → supplier ships to CN consolidation warehouse → your forwarder
platforms.cross_border_notes: Domestic CN logistics only; cross-border fulfillment is buyer's responsibility. CN labeling laws apply. Currency: CNY to supplier. SAFE currency control applies to outbound payments from CN.
platforms.tos_risk: Low for authorized API use. Cross-border/procurement apps need separate application review. ToS permits programmatic access for approved developers.
key_findings: Enterprise developer account required (individual devs have limited permissions)
Public product catalog fully accessible via alibaba.product.get — key difference vs Taobao
Wholesale sourcing APIs (寻源通) require separate permission application
Basic APIs free; high-frequency/advanced features need paid resource packages
Procurement loop: overseas order → 1688 procurement → CN warehouse → forwarder

platforms.entity_required: Foreign corporation OK; adzone_id from pub.alimama.com (Taobao Union account)
platforms.auth: TOP protocol; adzone_id (mm_xxx_xxx_12345678 last segment); MD5/HMAC signature
platforms.catalog_access: taobao.ovs.tbk.material.item.optional — overseas union catalog. Sites: GLOBAL (no restricted logic), HK, TW, MY, SG, AU, CA, MO. Languages: zh_CN, en_US. Returns click_url, coupon_share_url, income_rate, commission types (MKT/SP/COMMON/ZX).
platforms.order_model: Affiliate redirect only. User clicks promotion_link → Taobao/Tmall → purchase → commission on TradeCompleted. Cookie window: 3 days (per AliExpress pattern).
platforms.cross_border_notes: No customs/logistics involvement — pure affiliate. Alimama settles commissions to foreign bank accounts (HK/US). GLOBAL site bypasses restricted sales logic.
platforms.tos_risk: Low for authorized Taobao Union affiliates. Must comply with Alimama promotion rules. No scraping permitted.
key_findings: Explicit overseas API with multi-site support (GLOBAL, HK, TW, SG, MY, AU, CA, MO)
English language support (en_US)
Returns ready-to-use affiliate links (click_url, coupon_share_url)
Commission rates included in response (income_rate, commission_type)
adzone_id required from pub.alimama.com

platforms.catalog_access: No public catalog/sourcing API. Merchant open platform (open.pinduoduo.com) is for sellers managing own stores only.
platforms.cross_border_notes: Cross-border = Temu (separate entity, no API). No programmatic sourcing from Pinduoduo domestic catalog.
platforms.tos_risk: N/A — no public API to violate
key_findings: Open platform is merchant-facing only (seller tools, not buyer/sourcing)
Temu is PDD's cross-border arm but has no public API (see Temu entry)
No affiliate program with public API discovered

platforms.catalog_access: No public affiliate/sourcing API. JD Open Platform (open.jd.com) is for merchants. JD Worldwide requires merchant onboarding.
platforms.cross_border_notes: JD Worldwide is merchant-onboarding only. No programmatic product feed for foreign affiliates/sourcers.
key_findings: JD Open Platform targets merchants, not affiliates/sourcers
JD Worldwide cross-border entry requires Chinese entity + invitation

platforms.catalog_access: No public sourcing API. Douyin Shop (抖音小店) open platform is for merchants only. TikTok Shop cross-border is separate program.
platforms.cross_border_notes: TikTok Shop cross-border requires application/approval per market. No public product feed API.
key_findings: Douyin Shop API: merchant order/product management only
TikTok Shop: separate cross-border seller program, not a sourcing API

platforms.entity_required: Affiliate: foreign corp OK. Merchant API: paid GGS (Gold Supplier) subscription required.
platforms.auth: Affiliate: Alimama/proprietary tracking (no MMP). Merchant API: TOP protocol, AppKey+AppSecret+session, HMAC/MD5.
platforms.catalog_access: Affiliate: portals.aliexpress.com/adcenter/affiliateProductSearch.htm (manual search). Merchant API: alibala.product.search (needs permission, free tier QPS=10). No public bulk catalog API for affiliates.
platforms.order_model: Affiliate: redirect to Alibaba.com → TradeCompleted settlement (180-day window). Commission: new buyer <$5k 8% (ads.alibaba.com) / 2.59%-6.91% (Awin); existing buyer <$5k 3%. Fixed fees for larger orders. Russia/Ukraine/Iran/NK/Syria/Cuba/Nigeria blocked.
platforms.cross_border_notes: Alibaba.com is B2B export FROM China. Foreign sellers cannot use it as sales channel. Affiliate commissions paid to foreign bank. No MMP/AppsFlyer — proprietary attribution only.
platforms.tos_risk: Medium: country restrictions (Russia blocked), no third-party tracking, 180-day settlement window, commission assessed on 'traffic quality' at Alibaba's discretion.
key_findings: Affiliate program real: up to 15% commission (ads.alibaba.com) or 2.59%-6.91% (Awin)
Russia and 6 other countries blocked from commission eligibility
Merchant Open API requires paid Gold Supplier subscription
Product search API exists but gated (permission + QPS=10 free tier)
Settlement only on TradeCompleted; 180-day max order-to-payment gap

platforms.entity_required: Foreign corporation OK. Requires AliExpress Portals approval + business license + Open Platform dev account.
platforms.auth: OAuth 2.0 (oauth.aliexpress.com/authorize + /token) + TOP protocol (gw.api.taobao.com/router/rest) with HMAC/MD5 (NO SHA-256).
platforms.catalog_access: 11 affiliate endpoints: hotproduct.query, hotproduct.download (bulk + promotion_link), product.query, product.smartmatch, productdetail.get, category.get, image.search, featuredpromo.get, featuredpromo.products.get, cutflow.test. Returns: commission_rate, hot_product_commission_rate, original_price, sale_price, target_app_sale_price (per target_currency), ship_to_country pricing, delivery_days, evaluate_rate, lastest_volume, product images/video, category taxonomy.
platforms.order_model: Affiliate redirect via promotion_link (s.click.aliexpress.com). ship_to_country returns destination-country price per tax policy. delivery_days: 3/5/7/10. target_currency (16), target_language (22).
platforms.cross_border_notes: Landed cost computable from feed: ship_to_country + delivery_days = per-destination pricing + logistics. Multi-currency/multi-language built into API. Russia (RUB) and EU currencies supported. Seller is Chinese; AliExpress handles cross-border logistics.
platforms.tos_risk: Low for approved affiliates. Daily quota ~5,000 req/day (unverified, 2025 source). Manual review ~2 days. Affiliate API access separate from Dropship API (different permission scope).
key_findings: 11 verified affiliate endpoints on TOP protocol
hotproduct.download includes promotion_link (ready-made tracking links) — highest value endpoint
ship_to_country returns price per destination tax policy — landed cost is a lookup, not simulation
target_currency (16) + target_language (22) = pre-localized titles/prices
HMAC/MD5 only — no SHA-256 (community SDKs reporting SHA-256 are wrong)
Onboarding: Portals approval → Open Platform dev account → Affiliate API app type → biz license

platforms.catalog_access: None. partner.temu.com returns 702-byte JS shell ('enable JavaScript'). temu.com/temu-partner.html returns 2,889-byte empty shell. No developer docs, endpoints, SDK, auth docs, rate limits.
platforms.cross_border_notes: Temu handles cross-border logistics internally. No programmatic access for affiliates or sellers.
platforms.tos_risk: High if attempting grey automation. No public API = any scraping/automation is ToS violation.
key_findings: Both official partner URLs are JS-only shells with no server-rendered content
No developer documentation, endpoint catalogue, SDK, or authentication documentation discoverable
Private/invite-only API possible but unconfirmed (confidence 4/10)
Strategic recommendation: curated human CSV only; grey automation rejected

platforms.entity_required: Chinese legal entity required (separate international seller cabinet)
platforms.catalog_access: Seller API variant: product import, list, price, analytics. Similar to domestic Ozon Seller API (~70% coverage) but with currency operations.
platforms.order_model: Order management via API. International shipping integration required. FBO/FBS models. Seller handles CN export customs + RU import customs.
platforms.cross_border_notes: Currency control: CNY/RUB (CIPS, not SWIFT). Chinese export docs + Russian import docs (EAC, ГОСТ certificates). VAT/NDFL complexity. API coverage ~65%. Browser automation fallback easy.
platforms.tos_risk: Low for authorized sellers. Strict product certification requirements. Chinese entity mandatory.
key_findings: Separate international seller cabinet required
Chinese legal entity mandatory
Currency control CNY/RUB; CIPS not SWIFT
Stricter product certificates vs domestic Ozon
API coverage ~65%; browser automation easy fallback

platforms.auth: JWT Token (Header) — obtained in seller cabinet
platforms.catalog_access: Content API (cards), Marketplace API (orders/supplies), Statistics API, Advertising API, Prices API. Similar to WB Russia but Chinese UI.
platforms.order_model: Orders, supplies, warehouses via API. Logistics: China warehouses → Russia (FBO/FBS).
platforms.cross_border_notes: Taxes: Chinese export + Russian import. Timezone sync required. Language: CN/RU only. API coverage ~55%. High 2FA impact. Browser automation complex (captcha, fingerprinting).
platforms.tos_risk: Low for authorized sellers. Chinese UI and strict 2FA are operational barriers.
key_findings: Chinese legal entity mandatory
Chinese-only UI (requires localization)
API coverage ~55% (lower than Ozon)
High 2FA friction; browser automation difficult
Logistics: CN warehouse → RU (FBO/FBS)

platforms.entity_required: Chinese individual + 实名认证 (real-name verification) + Chinese phone number. Foreign entities cannot legally operate accounts.
platforms.auth: QR-code login only (no username/password). mtop/h5api endpoints exist (h5api.m.goofish.com) but protected by x5secdata anti-bot. DeviceId, utid, x-sign required.
platforms.catalog_access: No public API. CSR-only SPA (no SSR). mtop endpoints reverse-engineered but require valid session + anti-bot tokens. Region-gated: iOS app absent from US App Store; content filtered by region.
platforms.order_model: No programmatic order flow. Alipay CN only. Domestic C2C transactions only.
platforms.cross_border_notes: Payoneer blocked by SAFE 汇发〔2019〕13号 (requires 'store binding' transaction data — inapplicable to service/platform models). HK entity does not bypass PRC regulations (粤港地下钱庄 crackdown 2025-2026). AI labeling law (标识办法, 2025-09-01) mandatory.
platforms.tos_risk: CRITICAL. ToS §4.2.2(六) prohibits commercial use of content. §4.6.3 bans automated access, scraping, circumvention of region limits. Legal + technical + payment blockers at every layer.
key_findings: VERDICT: CLOSED — technically, legally, payment-wise blocked (goofish DECISION.md)
CSR-only SPA, no SSR; x5secdata WAF blocks automated requests
CN phone + 实名认证 mandatory; region-gated (iOS not in US App Store)
ToS §4.2.2(六) bans commercial use; §4.6.3 bans automation/scraping
Payoneer blocked by 汇发〔2019〕13号; HK entity not a legal workaround
AI content labeling law (标识办法) applies to any 中国 传播服务
EU AI Act Art. 50 extraterritorial deployer liability if AI output used in EU

partial_both: Alibaba.com (affiliate only; merchant API needs GGS)
